newsitem.title: CHINA: China's oldest panda celebrates 35th birthday.
newsitem.headline: China's oldest panda celebrates 35th birthday.

text.p: Dudu, the world's oldest living captive giant panda, has celebrated her 35th birthday with a special dinner of milk and cake in a zoo in central China, state television said on Monday.

Dudu, a huge red bow tied around her waist, slurped from a large bowl of milk while her keepers lit candles on her cake. Dudu has lost most of her teeth and can only eat the most tender of bamboo stalks, Chinese Central Television said.
Pandas seldom live beyond the age of 25.
Dudu's keepers at Wuhan Zoo in Hubei province planned to enter her for the Guinness Book of Records as the world's oldest living panda in captivity, the television said.
Lili, a panda at the Beijing Zoo, lived until the ripe old age of 29.
